svg.title: Arrange rules
svg.desc: Arrange rules: seven steps of one dungeon trip. Each box is what the game does; each speech bubble is what the player is thinking. The same text is in the README.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
